name: Header & Footer
what_it_does: Repeat content at the top/bottom of every page and number the pages; editing them activates the Header & Footer contextual tab.
affects: the header/footer stories of every page
behavior: Repeat content at the top/bottom of every page and number the pages; editing them activates the Header & Footer contextual tab. Group controls: subfeature:header-insert, subfeature:footer-insert, subfeature:page-number-insert

connections.why: headers/footers render on every page the page structure creates
